name: Echo CS-355T / CS-361P
blurb: 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain on 14″ (52 links) and 16″ (57 links) bars for both saws, plus a 12″ (45-link) bar for the CS-355T, per Echo's chart.
intro: The CS-355T (top handle) and CS-361P (rear handle) share a 35.8 cc engine and Echo lists the same 14″ and 16″ bar and chain for both: 3/8″ low-profile pitch, .050″ gauge, 52 drive links (91PXL52CQ) at 14″ and 57 (91PXL57CQ) at 16″, sharpened with a 5/32″ file. The CS-355T also has a 12″ row in Echo's chart, with 45 links of 91PX chain on bar 12A0ED3745C, although Echo's specification table lists only 14″ and 16″ for it. These saws use their own bars: the 14″ and 16″ part numbers (14A0ES3752C, 16A0ES3757C) differ from the CD-series bars on Echo's smaller saws, even though the chain spec is the same. Match the bar part or stamp, not just the length, if you are buying a replacement bar.

bars.note: Echo bar 12A0ED3745C; chain 91PX45CQ. Chart row for the CS-355T only (the CS-361P entry starts at 14″). Echo's specification table gives 14″ and 16″ as the CS-355T's bar lengths, so the 12″ setup appears only in the Bars and Chains chart.
bars.label: 12″ (CS-355T)

bars.note: Echo bar 14A0ES3752C; chain 91PXL52CQ. Listed for both the CS-355T and the CS-361P. Low-vibration semi-chisel PXL chain.
Echo bar 16A0ES3757C; chain 91PXL57CQ. Listed for both the CS-355T and the CS-361P. Low-vibration semi-chisel PXL chain.
